sources.shortCitation: Gloria, “Adieu es ist zu schön um wahr zu sein” (Bernhard Etté, 1933)
sources.fullCitation: Bernhard Etté mit seinem Tanz-Orchester, sung by Wolfgang Schmidt. “Adieu es ist zu schön um wahr zu sein.” Tango by Walter Jurmann, Bronislaw Kaper and Fritz Rotter from the film Abenteuer am Lido. The upload describes a Lindström recording of 1933, issued on Gloria in Germany and on Odeon abroad, and gives no catalogue number. Shellac disc from the Schallarchiv of the Radiomuseum Hardthausen. Accessed 20 August 2026.
sources.title: Adieu, es ist zu schön, um wahr zu sein — Gloria, Bernhard Etté
sources.creator: Bernhard Etté mit seinem Tanz-Orchester; Wolfgang Schmidt, vocal

sources.shortCitation: Gloria G.O. 10197, “Wer weint heut' aus Liebe Tränen?”
sources.fullCitation: Melody Gents, modernes Schlager-Quartett mit Orchester. “Wer weint heut' aus Liebe Tränen?” Slowfox aus dem Tonfilm „Ehe mit beschränkter Haftung“. Gloria, Katalog-Nr. G.O. 10197, side marked b, matrix Bi 412, 1932. The uploader's description transcribes the label as crediting the music to “Dr. Bronislaw Kaper – Walter Jurmann” and the words to “Fritz Rotter”, and names the quartet; the disc itself is not shown in the YouTube upload. Uploaded 19 June 2014. Accessed 21 August 2026.
sources.title: Wer weint heut' aus Liebe Tränen? — Gloria G.O. 10197
sources.creator: Melody Gents, modernes Schlager-Quartett mit Orchester

sources.shortCitation: Gloria G.O. 10155, “Mondnacht in Sanssouci” (Eric Harden with John Hendrik, 1931)
sources.fullCitation: Eric Harden und sein Tanz-Orchester, refrain sung by John Hendrik. “Mondnacht in Sanssouci.” Gloria G.O. 10155, matrix Bi 80; recorded 29 April 1931. Title list at musiktiteldb.de, compiled by Henry König from discographic and trade sources; no transfer of the disc has been located. Accessed 21 August 2026.
